title: 初級沉澱池設計~Primary clarifier design
focus: 沉降、水力分配與初沉污泥收支~Settling, flow distribution and primary-sludge balance
summary: 本課以沉降、水力分配與初沉污泥收支為主線，從懸浮固體進流、沉降速度與池深、表面溢流率、有效停留與短流進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops settling, flow distribution and primary-sludge balance through ten connected units, beginning with influent suspended-solids loading, settling velocity and depth, surface overflow rate, effective residence and bypass. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 懸浮固體進流~Influent suspended-solids loading
units.mechanism: 初沉池去除可沉固體，負荷需以 TSS、沉降性與流量共同界定。~Primary clarification targets settleable solids; define loading with TSS, settleability and flow.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；C=180 mg/L。模型 L=QC/1000，代入得到 360 kg/d。適用邊界：穩定流量與流量加權濃度；瞬時樣本不代表整日。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; C=180 mg/L. Model L=QC/1000 gives 360 kg/d. Applicability: Steady flow and flow-weighted concentration; a grab sample does not represent a day.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「懸浮固體進流」的觀測點。比對累積流量計與流量比例混合樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for influent suspended-solids loading. Compare the totalizing flowmeter with a flow-proportional composite sample. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只看濁度替代固體質量。診斷與介入：先回查濃度基準與流量加權採樣，再重算負荷。~Turbidity is used as a substitute for solids mass. Diagnostic response: First check the concentration basis and flow-weighted sampling, then recalculate loading.
units.misconception: 濁度值可直接當 kg 固體負荷。~Turbidity directly gives kilograms of solids load.
units.practice: 只改變 C:180→210 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 360 變為 420 kg/d。用「懸浮固體進流」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only C:180→210 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 360 to 420 kg/d. Explain the direction using influent suspended-solids loading, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 沉降速度與池深~Settling velocity and depth
units.mechanism: 理想粒子沉降提供量級，但污水絮凝讓粒徑與沉速沿途改變。~Ideal settling gives scale, while flocculation changes particle size and velocity en route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：粒子沉速=1.2 m/h；池深=3 m。模型 ts=H/vs，代入得到 2.5 h。適用邊界：單一離散粒子示例；實際絮凝與阻礙沉降不服從固定沉速。~Original teaching assumptions: Particle settling velocity=1.2 m/h; depth=3 m. Model ts=H/vs gives 2.5 h. Applicability: Single discrete-particle example; flocculent/hindered settling has no fixed velocity.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「沉降速度與池深」的觀測點。用沉降柱畫界面高度與時間，不以單點判定。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for settling velocity and depth. Plot settling-column interface height against time rather than using one point. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把單一粒子速率當全部污泥行為。診斷與介入：用沉降曲線與有效水深核對，檢查短流及再懸浮。~One-particle velocity is taken as all sludge behavior. Diagnostic response: Check settling curves/effective depth and investigate bypass/resuspension.
units.misconception: 所有顆粒都有相同沉速。~Every particle has the same settling velocity.
units.practice: 只改變 vs:1.2→0.8 m/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2.5 變為 3.75 h。用「沉降速度與池深」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only vs:1.2→0.8 m/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2.5 to 3.75 h. Explain the direction using settling velocity and depth, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 表面溢流率~Surface overflow rate
units.mechanism: 面積與水量決定表面水力負荷，增加深度並不直接降低這項指標。~Area and flow determine surface hydraulic loading; depth does not directly lower it.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=3000 m³/d；A=120 m²。模型 SOR=Q/A，代入得到 25 m/d。適用邊界：表面溢流率只是一個水力指標，不能單獨決定絮凝沉降效率。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=3000 m³/d; A=120 m². Model SOR=Q/A gives 25 m/d. Applicability: Surface overflow rate is a hydraulic metric, not a complete predictor of flocculent settling.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「表面溢流率」的觀測點。將流量、池面積與沉降柱結果一起比較。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for surface overflow rate. Compare flow and plan area with settling-column observations. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只加深卻以為表面負荷降低。診斷與介入：比較分池流量及沉降測試，先評估配流是否失衡。~Deepening alone is assumed to reduce surface loading. Diagnostic response: Compare cell flows and settling tests, first checking distribution imbalance.
units.misconception: 池深加倍就使表面溢流率減半。~Doubling depth halves surface overflow rate.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:3000→4200 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 25 變為 35 m/d。用「表面溢流率」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:3000→4200 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 25 to 35 m/d. Explain the direction using surface overflow rate, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 有效停留與短流~Effective residence and bypass
units.mechanism: 進流消能、擋板與出流配置會影響短流，示蹤比單看 V/Q 更有資訊。~Inlet dissipation, baffles and outlets influence bypass; tracing reveals more than V/Q alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：V=1500 m³；Q=3000 m³/d。模型 θ=24V/Q，代入得到 12 h。適用邊界：名義水力停留時間；不包含短流、死角及回流的停留時間分布。~Original teaching assumptions: V=1500 m³; Q=3000 m³/d. Model θ=24V/Q gives 12 h. Applicability: Nominal hydraulic residence time; it does not resolve short-circuiting, dead zones or recirculation residence-time distributions.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「有效停留與短流」的觀測點。以槽有效容積與示蹤劑穿透曲線交叉檢查。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effective residence and bypass. Cross-check effective volume with a tracer breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 角落死水與中間高速流並存。診斷與介入：用示蹤曲線及有效容積修正假設，先在模擬中比較分流方案。~Dead corners coexist with a fast central path. Diagnostic response: Revise assumptions using tracing/effective volume and compare flow-distribution options in simulation first.
units.misconception: 平均停留時間長就沒有短流。~Long mean residence eliminates bypass.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:3000→3600 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 12 變為 10 h。用「有效停留與短流」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:3000→3600 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 12 to 10 h. Explain the direction using effective residence and bypass, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 出水堰分配~Effluent-weir distribution
units.mechanism: 堰頂標高與局部負荷影響均勻出流，維護不平會吸走局部絮體。~Weir level and local loading control distribution; uneven crests draw local floc.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=3000 m³/d；堰長=40 m。模型 WL=Q/Lw，代入得到 75 m³/(m·d)。適用邊界：平均堰負荷不反映堰板不平與局部流量偏置。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=3000 m³/d; weir length=40 m. Model WL=Q/Lw gives 75 m³/(m·d). Applicability: Mean weir loading does not reveal uneven weirs or local flow bias.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「出水堰分配」的觀測點。逐段檢查堰頂高程與出流分布。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effluent-weir distribution. Check weir crest elevation and discharge distribution segment by segment. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 長堰未調平仍發生偏流。診斷與介入：對照堰高程與沿堰流量，查局部偏流及附著物。~A long unlevel weir still causes maldistribution. Diagnostic response: Compare weir elevation/local flow and inspect uneven flow/deposits.
units.misconception: 堰越長就不用調平。~Longer weirs need no leveling.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:3000→4200 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 75 變為 105 m³/(m·d)。用「出水堰分配」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:3000→4200 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 75 to 105 m³/(m·d). Explain the direction using effluent-weir distribution, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 有機物去除與後段~Organic removal and downstream demand
units.mechanism: 初沉去除有機物可減少曝氣負荷，也可能減少後段反硝化碳。~Primary organic removal can reduce aeration demand and downstream denitrification carbon.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Cin=100 mg/L；Cout=20 mg/L。模型 η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin，代入得到 0.8 fraction。適用邊界：濃度去除率僅在進出流量相等時等於質量去除率。~Original teaching assumptions: Cin=100 mg/L; Cout=20 mg/L. Model η=(Cin-Cout)/Cin gives 0.8 fraction. Applicability: Concentration removal equals mass removal only for equal inlet/outlet flow.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「有機物去除與後段」的觀測點。用相同分析方法與流量加權樣本，另列流量差異。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for organic removal and downstream demand. Use matching methods and flow-weighted samples and report any flow difference. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只追求最大初沉去除而忽略後段需要。診斷與介入：配對進出水流量及分析基準，另外確認轉化產物。~Maximizing primary removal ignores downstream needs. Diagnostic response: Match inlet/outlet flow and analysis bases and check transformation products separately.
units.misconception: 初沉去除率最高永遠最有利。~Maximum primary removal is always best.
units.practice: 只改變 Cout:20→30 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.8 變為 0.7 fraction。用「有機物去除與後段」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Cout:20→30 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.8 to 0.7 fraction. Explain the direction using organic removal and downstream demand, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 污泥排出基準~Sludge-withdrawal basis
units.mechanism: 排泥需用固體質量閉合，濃度與體積變動不能單獨判讀。~Close sludge removal on a solids-mass basis; concentration and volume alone are insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。~Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「污泥排出基準」的觀測點。由體積、密度與烘乾固體三個獨立量測建質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge-withdrawal basis. Build mass from independent volume, density and oven-dry solids measurements. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 排出體積增加但濃度下降。診斷與介入：用代表性含固樣本重算乾量，避免濕重混用。~Withdrawal volume rises while solids concentration falls. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry mass from representative solids samples, without mixing wet mass.
units.misconception: 多排一倍體積就多排一倍乾固體。~Twice the sludge volume always removes twice the dry solids.
units.practice: 只改變 TS:0.04→0.05，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2000 變為 2500 kg DS/d。用「污泥排出基準」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only TS:0.04→0.05, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2000 to 2500 kg DS/d. Explain the direction using sludge-withdrawal basis, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 尖峰水力情境~Peak hydraulic scenario
units.mechanism: 雨天峰流可能比平均水量更影響固體逃逸，需重播峰值歷線。~Wet-weather peaks can drive solids escape more than mean flow; replay hydrographs.
units.model: 原創教學假設：峰流=6000 m³/d；平均流=3000 m³/d。模型 PF=Qpeak/Qmean，代入得到 2 ratio。適用邊界：平均、瞬時峰與設計事件尺度須標明，不能用日平均代替尖峰。~Original teaching assumptions: Peak flow=6000 m³/d; mean flow=3000 m³/d. Model PF=Qpeak/Qmean gives 2 ratio. Applicability: State averaging and event scales; a daily mean cannot replace a short-term peak.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「尖峰水力情境」的觀測點。比較分鐘流量序列與每日累積水量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for peak hydraulic scenario. Compare minute-scale flow with daily total volume. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以日均流量判定短時超載。診斷與介入：用實際峰值歷線重播，查瞬時水位及下游能力。~Daily mean flow is used to judge brief overload. Diagnostic response: Replay actual peak hydrographs and check instantaneous levels/downstream capacity.
units.misconception: 日均流量不高就不會水力超載。~Low daily average prevents hydraulic overload.
units.practice: 只改變 Qpeak:6000→7500 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2 變為 2.5 ratio。用「尖峰水力情境」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qpeak:6000→7500 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2 to 2.5 ratio. Explain the direction using peak hydraulic scenario, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 污泥與上清混合~Sludge and supernatant mixing
units.mechanism: 回流水的溶解有機物與固體須重新納入進流，不可當作無負荷清水。~Return liquids add dissolved organics/solids and are not load-free water.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q1=1000、Q2=500 m³/d；C1=20、C2=80 mg/L。模型 Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)，代入得到 40 mg/L。適用邊界：無反應、同一成分與相同濃度基準；不可直接套用 pH。~Original teaching assumptions: Q1=1000, Q2=500 m³/d; C1=20, C2=80 mg/L. Model Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2) gives 40 mg/L. Applicability: No reaction and the same species/concentration basis; do not directly average pH this way.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「污泥與上清混合」的觀測點。量兩股流量與成分，再在混合充分的位置採樣。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge and supernatant mixing. Measure both flows and concentrations, then sample after adequate mixing. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 旁流接回入口但未納入採樣。診斷與介入：核對兩股流量及同成分分析，避免以簡單平均混合。~Returned sidestreams are excluded from sampling. Diagnostic response: Check both flows and same-species analyses rather than arithmetic averaging.
units.misconception: 廠內回流水不增加處理負荷。~Internal returns add no treatment load.
units.practice: 只改變 Q2:500→750 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 40 變為 45.714286 mg/L。用「污泥與上清混合」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q2:500→750 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 40 to 45.714286 mg/L. Explain the direction using sludge and supernatant mixing, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 固體去向驗證~Solids-destination verification
units.mechanism: 把進流、出水、污泥與槽內庫存閉合，分辨真去除與暫時沉積。~Close influent, effluent, sludge and inventory to distinguish removal from temporary deposition.
units.model: 原創教學假設：進入=15、出流水=2、排泥=12 kg/d。模型 ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge，代入得到 1 kg/d。適用邊界：殘差可能來自儲存、漏算旁流與量測誤差，不能自動當作反應。~Original teaching assumptions: Input=15, effluent=2, sludge=12 kg/d. Model ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge gives 1 kg/d. Applicability: Residual can reflect storage, omitted side streams or measurement error, not automatically a reaction.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「固體去向驗證」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for solids-destination verification. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 槽內堆積被誤當穩定去除。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。~Accumulation is mistaken for steady removal. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.
units.misconception: 沉到池底就永遠離開系統。~Settling to the floor permanently removes solids from the system.
units.practice: 只改變 Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1 變為 0.5 kg/d。用「固體去向驗證」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1 to 0.5 kg/d. Explain the direction using solids-destination verification, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
